name: vscode-external-secrets
description: Resolve secrets from a secrets manager into environment variables when you run or debug, mapped per variable in launch.json.

commands.title: External Secrets: Open Terminal With Secrets

externalSecrets.aws.profile.description: Default AWS profile used when a reference or launch configuration does not specify one. When unset, the AWS SDK credential chain is used.

externalSecrets.aws.region.description: Default AWS region used when a reference or launch configuration does not specify one. When unset, the region comes from the AWS profile or environment.

externalSecrets.cache.ttlSeconds.description: How long resolved secrets stay in the in-memory cache. Values are never written to disk. Set to 0 to disable caching.

externalSecrets.log.level.description: Verbosity of the External Secrets output channel. Secret values are never logged at any level.

externalSecrets.terminal.namedSets.description: Named sets of secret references, usable by the terminal and .env export commands. Each value has the same shape as the externalSecrets block of a launch configuration.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
